help.title: How to play
help.how:
• Get every item on the "Required" list into the truck before time runs out.
• Big items show 2/6 👐: you need that many people holding them at once. "strict" items won't budge until enough people grab.
• Hold your direction while running — but you might trip. Thrown and dropped items can break.
• The landlord is watching: breaking things lowers satisfaction and your score.
• Other people on this computer join by pressing Grab (Enter / A).
